architectureDecisions: D1 — BB-155 Work/Attempt/version/Decision + BB-157 own control; immutable evidence blobs, existing apply only. No new phase/database.
D2 — Request/run/observations are EvidenceVersion blob refs, PUBLISH_EVIDENCE CAS/live fence only; suggestion is not Decision/readiness.
D3 — Strict bindingContract exact subjects and authority classes; input evidence versus output evidence avoids self-hash recursion.
D4 — Pinned registry DAG, sequential stable order, publish outcome before next launch; dependency cancellation truthful, full verification mandatory.
D5 — failureContract: product delta, verifier correction, infra <=2 retries, flake <=1 confirmation then hold; JEV transport never multiplied.
D6 — loopContract selective input closure, unknown->all, new trusted unchanged-input attestation only; no cross-Attempt reuse/fresh npm verify.
D7 — Pure action intersects actual nextActions; failed JEV BB-157 LOOKBACK/reflection/material guard; allSAT->merge, exact receipt->delivery.
D8 — adapterContract exact canonical request/controller/authority, secret-free runner/trusted importer; GitHub metadata cannot select or advance Work.
D9 — Delivered BB-155/157 required for Worker; legacy stays unchanged, isolated V2 explicit route. BB-156 owns cutover/no dual-write.
D10 — Seven bounded slices, actual adversarial exports and paired benchmark; Living describes delivered behavior only, research ends READY.

Strict refs/hash/closed keys/partitions/PASS/full logs/authority. Test real exports with each stale/forged/partial binding and positive native publication. Own CANONICAL_FEEDBACK_CONTRACT/FAILURE_TAXONOMY. validateRequest(request,resolved), acceptVerificationObservation(observation,request,resolved), validateRun(run,request,observations); no fs/store writes.

S2 — scripts/agent-native-ci/planner.mjs exports planVerification/planReverification: exact request/prior run/resolved input delta -> pure stable topological schedule and invalidation/reuse reasons. Unknown deps ->all, reverse closure, no cross-Attempt reuse, fresh mandatory npm verify. Actual export tests cover source/env/registry delta, cyclic/duplicate gates and forged old PASS. Own SELECTIVE_VERIFICATION/AGENT_CONTROL_LOOP. planVerification(request)->checks; planReverification({request,priorRun,sourceDelta,resolvedInputs})->{checks,invalidated,reused,reasons}.

S3 — scripts/agent-native-ci/runner.mjs exports executeVerificationRequest/publishVerificationRun: pinned request, clean checkout, blobStore, client/current token -> argv process + full hashed logs + incremental/final EvidenceVersion via PUBLISH_EVIDENCE CAS. Implement failureContract bounds, reap/cancel/accounting, no secrets/new SQL. Actual runner/store tests for every outcome, stale callbacks/lease/CAS/restart/conflict; first failure before dependent launch. Own FAILURE_TAXONOMY/CANONICAL_FEEDBACK_CONTRACT/AGENT_CONTROL_LOOP. Native record refs retain {kind,id,hash}; EvidenceVersion uses existing header and hashed result/blob content, no unknown Work/status keys.

S4 — scripts/agent-native-ci/feedback.mjs + V2 trust-adapter exports deriveVerificationAction/buildJevInput: current snapshot/resolved run -> advisory intersection with actual nextActions and existing typed judgment input. Follow loopContract, preserve forbidden lifecycle/store/supervision and evaluator grammar. Real native fixtures test failed Decision LOOKBACK/reflection/material/signature guard, zero unchanged dispatch, allSAT merge and receipt-only delivery. Own AGENT_CONTROL_LOOP/JEV_BOUNDARY. deriveVerificationAction(snapshot,resolvedRun)->{suggestion,blockers}; buildJevInput(snapshot,resolvedRun)->existing materialized envelope or blocker.

S5 — scripts/agent-native-ci/github-adapter.mjs/scripts/agent-native-ci/cli.mjs + jev-ci + three workflows + package.json: projectGitHubStatus/validateGitHubCallback; CLI run --config ABS --request REF --request-hash HASH, project --config ABS WORK_ID. Exact adapterContract, secret-free execution/trusted importer, lost upload unavailable, legacy unchanged. Actual exports tests mutate check/skip/head/base/body/SHA/authority/status API/two cwd: no Work effects. Own ADAPTER_BOUNDARY. projectGitHubStatus(snapshot,resolvedRun)->metadata projection, validateGitHubCallback(callback,request,resolved)->bound import facts or rejection.

livingDocs.statement: Living system state must describe CI as an agent-facing verification execution/feedback plane with exact candidate-bound evidence, explicit authority boundaries, progressive failure semantics and GitHub Actions as an adapter only after the contract is actually delivered.

valueHypothesis: Reducing CI from a human-oriented terminal gate to a machine-readable feedback/control plane should shorten agent failure-to-repair latency, eliminate PR/check-state authority leaks, and make autonomous delivery retries/re-verification more correct and cheaper. Research must measure these claims before optimization.

ciContract.canonical: Native EvidenceVersion/CAS/fence only; exact bindingContract, loopContract, failureContract, adapterContract in objective evidence. No new phase/store/Decision. Mandatory full verify + independent JEV + actual main/tree/Living receipt; BB-157 supervision, BB-156 cutover.

auditEvidence.coverage: Every file below inspected at exact baseline; full byte/hash inventory and raw timing retained in ci-surface-audit.json. Three workflows only. V2 source absent; merged BB-155/157 plans are future contracts.
paths: .github/workflows/test.yml: PR event fixed base/head/body -> living-doc-impact classification + kernel npm verify -> blackboard-gate select -> optional semantic matrix/readiness-verify/objective-supersession-verify -> always merge-gate. Empty matrices may skip, applicable jobs must succeed and each sha==event head. GitHub needs controls launch/actuation, typed JEV supplies correctness.
.github/workflows/push-test.yml: every push checkout -> Node24 npm verify -> terminal kernel conclusion; no Work selector/evidence/JEV. Duplicate PR/push execution, no canonical observation.

.github/workflows/blackboard-jev.yml: workflow_call/dispatch work_id + candidate/trusted/controller inputs (missing dispatch SHAs default main) -> resolve actual SHAs -> select exactly1 -> secret-free collect artifact jev-input-ID -> evaluate with provider secret -> always upload jev-evaluation-ID/cache. Node22 collector/evaluator, cancel-in-progress=false per work/candidate; failed collection suppresses evaluate, missing artifact is infra/insufficient not product judgment.

scripts/blackboard-jev-ci.mjs: trusted base Board selects changed research plan, exact worker candidate, READY publication or supersession. Candidate objective/policy not trusted. Copies trusted docs then restores permitted research draft/baseline; collect -> verification bundle, evaluate -> materialize/evaluate/validate actual verdict; unsatisfied exit1. Publication validates exact trusted plan/cache. GH snapshots select trusted transport refs, no V2 controller yet.

scripts/blackboard-jev.mjs: canonical objective/plan/subject/evidence -> typed required questions -> state/spec/model/policy cache -> independent provider -> validated all answers -> genuine JEV_EVALUATION. callJev max2 transport attempts/30s; research failure -> RESEARCH_REQUIRED, candidate failure -> repair/research. Confidence telemetry. No check conclusion enters verdict.

scripts/blackboard-delivery.mjs: clean exact candidate/baseline/plan -> sequential verificationPlan shell commands (300s each), write log then first error throws; IMPLEMENTATION_RESULT emitted only after all pass. publishEvaluation sets DRAFT/READY or repair from exact genuine verdict. verifyDelivery requires candidate ancestor merge ancestor observed main, equal candidate/merge tree and required Living/source blobs; publishDelivery sets DONE. Partial failed runs have logs but no final typed result.

scripts/blackboard-verification-bundle.mjs: result run logs + claims -> dedup union blobs; install checks canonical safe paths/missing bodies/every digest before write. Preserve checks; no failed/partial observation envelope currently.

scripts/blackboard-jev-cli.mjs and blackboard-implementation-bootstrap.mjs: explicit work id/profile -> graph contract/context -> collect/eval/publish/verify-delivery/claim; readiness/dependency/scope validated. graph/state projection after publication is legacy authority; local CLI needs no GH status.

packages/agentic-system/src/local-command-verifier.js: candidate.version==HEAD; argv shell:false + timeout/reap + stdout/stderr full digests; unchanged HEAD/status after execution. exit0 PASS, exit nonzero/SPAWN_ERROR both FAIL, TIMEOUT INCONCLUSIVE, mutation FAIL. No Work generation or structured domain taxonomy.

packages/agent-tools/src/supervisor.js: localCommandVerifier per task.verifications -> current candidate PASS set -> all claims evaluation -> Core promotion; maxAttempts default3 resumes feedback. Agent message/exit not authority, separate agent-tools contract.

All bind candidate.version; separate APIs retained, new CI wrapper adds V2 envelope without changing them.

findings: Tekton pipelines.md documents runAfter/results dependencies, retries (not cancellations), when-skips and finally outcome handling; taskruns/pipelineruns document retry attempts and cancellation status. Adopt explicit dependency/run accounting and separate result bytes from execution status.
Reject Tekton retry-on-failure as domain policy: ExHarness needs product/verifier/infra/flake distinctions and exact material progress. Do not add Kubernetes, Tekton dependency or another scheduler.

Current pinned GitHub workflows are primary executable evidence for event snapshots, needs/status, always upload and concurrency. Adapter inputs are exact V2 requests; never rediscover Work from PR metadata.
tradeoffs: Sequential registry DAG initially: reduce first-failure feedback latency by publishing after each check, no unmeasured concurrency optimization. Mandatory full repository verification remains mandatory before JEV/delivery.
Selective re-verification is fast feedback only in initial profile. No optimization can waive a required gate. Unknown dependencies force all checks.
Keep public Core/local verifier API unchanged: wrap current records and separately retain raw classified results. No meaning inferred from success prose or arbitrary summary text.
researchEvidence.limits: Single historical CI run and one failing local sample establish timings and concrete gaps only; no general performance/cost claim. Research models do not prove future controller implementation.

bindingContract.requestSchema: VERIFICATION_REQUEST_V1={id,hash,subject:{workId,workGeneration,specHash,planHash,attemptRef:{kind,id,hash},candidateVersionRef:{kind,id,hash},candidateSha,candidateTree,inputEvidenceRef:{ref,hash}|null},registryHash,policyHash,requiredGateIds,checks:[{id,verifier:{id,implementationHash,authorityClass:DETERMINISTIC},command,args,inputDigests:[{ref,hash}],dependencies,timeoutMs,maxOutputBytes}],retryPolicy:{infraRetries:2,flakeConfirmations:1},environment:{profile,hash},controllerDigest}. Strict known keys, immutable canonical hash excluding hash field; all refs resolve before scheduling, unique check ids, acyclic deps, required gate ids exactly approved plan. No PR/check fields in semantic subject.
bindingContract.observationSchema: VERIFICATION_OBSERVATION_V1={id,hash,requestRef:{ref,hash},subject:exact request.subject,checkId,verifier:exact registered verifier,executionId,executionState:COMPLETED|CANCELLED|UNAVAILABLE|PARTIAL,outcome:PASS|FAIL|INCONCLUSIVE,failureClass:NONE|PRODUCT|VERIFIER|INFRA|FLAKE_SUSPECTED|INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE|CANCELLED,exitCode:int|null,signal:string|null,evidence:[{ref,hash,bytes,complete:boolean}],inputDigests,attemptOrdinal,reuseOf:{ref,hash}|null,transport:optional metadata}. hash excludes hash; subject/input/verifier binds request, ordinal is canonical run accounting. PASS only completed exit0, verified full required evidence and no subject/tree mutation. Captured truncated preview distinct from full log blob/hash/bytes; missing full required evidence -> INCONCLUSIVE.
bindingContract.runSchema: EXECUTION_RUN_V1={id,hash,requestRef,subject,registryHash,policyHash,executions:[{executionId,checkId,ordinal,startedAt,finishedAt,observationRef}],plannedIds,completedIds,cancelledIds,unavailableIds,partialIds,pendingIds,retryHistory:[{checkId,ordinal,causeRef,class,policyHash}],previousRunRef:null|{ref,hash}}. Sets are disjoint and cover every planned id for latest outcome; executions retain all attempts/conflicts; pending allowed in incremental snapshots, terminal snapshot has pendingIds=[]. No ready/correct/delivered booleans. Timestamps runtime diagnostics only, not material evidence digest.
bindingContract.publication: publishVerificationRun({client,snapshot,request,run,observations,blobStore,attemptToken}) validates hashes/registry/subject/log closure and appends ordinary EvidenceVersion with these blob refs through apply(PUBLISH_EVIDENCE,expectedGeneration/RV). Store assigns native version identity and repeats current Attempt/lease/fence checks. Parallel callbacks conflict: reread current version, validate same subject then append immutable union using new CAS; conflicting same id/body rejects. Late generation/owner/candidate or read-only phase publication rejects with zero Work effect; preserve raw callback as non-authoritative diagnostic in external hash archive. No extra SQL or mutable run authority.
bindingContract.authorityClasses: Deterministic observation proves its declared executable check only. SEMANTIC_DECISION_REF_V1={decisionRef,workId,workGeneration,attemptRef,candidateVersionRef,evidenceVersionRef} resolves actual independently validated native Decision, never producer supplied answers. Unified routing envelope refers to either observation or Decision; authorityClass remains distinct. JEV failures route exclusively to BB-157 LOOKBACK; no feedback observation grants reflection acceptance or allSAT.

loopContract.progressiveExecution: planVerification(request) validates registry and topologically orders stable id tie-break: schema/binding -> focused negatives -> targeted tests -> full npm verify -> independent JEV. Initial runner concurrency=1. After each completed check publish incremental EvidenceVersion before next launch. Product blocking failure stops dependent checks, emits CANCELLED records for them, leaves independent diagnostic checks explicit; process-group termination reaps child before final accounting. Failure to publish/current fence lost stops launching, diagnostics retained only. Whole workflow cancellation may prevent finally callback; canonical controller later marks missing execution UNAVAILABLE by pinned run timeout, not by GitHub cancelled conclusion.
loopContract.feedbackLoop: deriveVerificationAction(snapshot,resolvedRun) checks exact freshness first; stale -> DISCARD_DIAGNOSTIC, invalid/missing -> ACQUIRE_EVIDENCE, product -> DIAGNOSE_AND_REPAIR with material candidate delta, verifier -> FIX_VERIFIER, infra allowed -> RETRY_CHECK with budget ordinal, flake -> CONFIRM_ONCE/HOLD, partial -> RECONCILE. suggestions must intersect existing nextActions legality, current scope/owner/dependencies and phase; no direct phase setter. Complete fresh mandatory passes -> REQUEST_CANDIDATE_JUDGMENT suggestion only if native guards allow; failure Decision -> READ_FAILURE/DERIVE_REFLECTION/PUBLISH_REFLECTION through BB-157; allSAT -> verify merge then native receipt. Generation/Attempt takeover clears applicability but does not reset retry history/material baseline; new semantic request binds changed inputs. Same request replay is idempotent.
loopContract.selective: planReverification({request,priorRun,sourceDelta,resolvedInputs}) computes changed registered input digests plus reverse dependency closure. Product changed authorized syntax-normalized implementation uses BB-157 trusted material profile; evidence delta uses typed observed projection; prose/control/id/timing churn cannot unlock product/JEV. Unknown/undeclared reads or env/profile change invalidate all. Proven unchanged input checks may get a new trusted REUSE_ATTESTATION observation bound new subject and reuseOf original, validate full original proof and input closure; no raw old PASS accepted. Cross-Attempt reuse disabled in initial profile. Required npm verify is never reused; fresh complete execution required before JEV/delivery.
loopContract.nativeIntegration: EvidenceVersion binds current Attempt/gen/spec/candidate; its body contains request/run/observation refs plus existing implementation evidence projection. Snapshot records resolve hashed blob closure before pure feedback. BB-155 accepts typed evidence payload refs; Worker compatibility test proves this with actual PUBLISH_EVIDENCE without modifying forbidden core. Extend only trust-adapter.mjs evidence loading/projection: require complete passing mandatory checks and exact subject before existing materializeWorkJudgment; preserve question grammar, negative test bindings, main/equal-tree/Living policy. No provider call on missing evidence; only actual REQUEST_CANDIDATE_JUDGMENT from existing nextActions/CAS and BB-157 guard can dispatch.

failureTaxonomy: COMPLETED/exit0 with exact full evidence -> PASS/NONE; no lifecycle advancement.

Trusted assertion adapter identifies executable product-test assertion failure -> FAIL/PRODUCT; raw nonzero unclassified command -> INCONCLUSIVE/VERIFIER, never assumed product defect. No rerun same product subject.

Spawn error, invalid verifier protocol/schema or test harness error -> INCONCLUSIVE/VERIFIER; fix declared verifier/config/environment with changed hash, new request. Existing local SPAWN_ERROR is mapped structurally from reason evidence token, not user prose.

Known runner eviction/network/artifact-upload outage -> INCONCLUSIVE/INFRA, full diagnostics and up to two additional executions on exact same subject; timeout default INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE unless trusted adapter establishes infra cause, never assume flake.

Same pinned subject/check/environment conflicting pass/fail or known nondeterminism -> INCONCLUSIVE/FLAKE_SUSPECTED; retain both, at most one diagnostic confirmation then HOLD even if confirmation passes; trusted policy/verifier correction and new complete evidence required.
Missing logs, unverified digest, incomplete executed coverage or timeout without cause -> INCONCLUSIVE/INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE; acquire missing proof or repair check, no product correctness inference.
Early dependent cancellation -> CANCELLED/INCONCLUSIVE; lost callback/runner -> UNAVAILABLE or PARTIAL/INCONCLUSIVE; reconcile exact run accounting, never green-on-skip.

adapterContract.githubAdapter: dispatch input={requestRef,requestHash,workId,workGeneration,attemptRef,candidateVersionRef,candidateSha,controllerDigest,authorityId,configuredClientRef}. Resolve pinned controller outside candidate checkout, verify request from canonical authority; no branch/current/PR fallback. Runner receives commands from approved registry, no judge/operator/provider secret. Narrow publication capability via trusted controller mediator; no fence/token in artifact/log. Callback raw files are hash validated by trusted importer; missing/wrong SHA/subject reject. status projection reads current canonical facts: no Work -> neutral, pending/partial -> pending, deterministic failure/blocker -> failure, current complete passes+independent allSAT -> success for semantic projection; merge actuation still requires actual candidate/main/tree/Living proof. Status API outage records adapter error only. Branch protection may block actuation but never creates Work facts. Old trigger event after head/base/body edit remains transport-old and cannot select subject.
adapterContract.legacyCompatibility: Default existing legacy CI unchanged while LEGACY selector active. Explicit canonical V2 request executes V2 adapter; no create from PR or graph discovery. On BB-156 cutover wrappers select pinned V2 authority; BB-158 does not migrate task ids/change selector, dual-write or reinterpret legacy DONE. Isolated V2 path can be delivered before migration.
adapterContract.dependencies: Worker pins actual delivered BB-155/157 controller identity, schema and exports. Mismatch returns research. READY plans on baseline are sufficient research design evidence, not runtime delivery.

benchmarkContract.protocol: Paired same fixture/candidate/hardware/runtime/commands per seed, baseline current sequential terminal collector versus progressive adapter. Publish every sample and failures, p50/p95 first diagnostic latency, total elapsed, spawned checks/cancelled counts, retry/provider counts and log/evidence bytes; unknown cost stays null. No live paid provider for timing; deterministic provider fixture counted as synthetic, genuine correctness gate separate. Timing uses monotonic clock outside semantic digests.
benchmarkContract.gates: All adversarial safety cases pass with zero false ready/delivery, zero stale effects and no repeated paid identical subject; progressive early-error first feedback precedes dependent launch. No performance regression over 10% median successful complete-run latency relative paired baseline; if sample noise blocks conclusion retain baseline scheduling and reopen optimization, not correctness gate. Full npm verify still mandatory.
benchmarkContract.limitation: No claimed productivity/speedup from these single baseline observations.

objectiveCoverage.objectiveCriterion: Audit every current CI/delivery verification path and identify where GitHub transport state, JEV state, deterministic verification and Blackboard lifecycle currently overlap or contradict.
Define one typed, immutable verification observation/evidence contract bound to exact Work generation, Attempt, candidate and verifier subject, including failure classification and freshness.
Define an agent control loop for progressive verification, early failure, diagnosis/repair, material-delta retry, selective re-verification, JEV supervision and convergence to delivery readiness.

Define fail-closed semantics for stale observations, verifier/infra failure, flaky suspicion, partial/cancelled runs and insufficient evidence without converting those states into product correctness claims.
Define the GitHub Actions adapter boundary so required checks/statuses are projections of canonical delivery state rather than inputs that create canonical state.
Produce a bounded implementation decomposition, negative cases, benchmark/evaluation plan and Living Docs impact ready for independent JEV review.
